audience: event organisers who report on attendees, sessions and ticket sales in Accelevents

useCases.title: Check check-ins and ticket sales for an event
useCases.text: List attendees with their ticket type and check-in data. Read ticket sales for each ticket type, with add-ons if asked.

useCases.title: Build the session list for the agenda
useCases.text: List the sessions of the event with their speakers and tracks. List the public sessions, filtered by tag, track or format.

useCases.title: Find speakers who have no session yet
useCases.text: List the speakers with their sessions. Compare the list with the session list to find speakers with no session.

useCases.title: Check the sessions one attendee can see
useCases.text: Find the attendee in the attendee list and read the user id. Then read every session that attendee can see.

useCases.title: Add a speaker to the event
useCases.text: Check the speaker list first. Then add a speaker record. The record appears in the event's speaker list.

useCases.title: Remove an attendee from a session
useCases.text: Read the sessions of one attendee. Then remove the session from that attendee's bookmarks.
